units.source_text: 据说13世纪开始就将吉野山的樱移植到岚山。

en.t: It is said that from the thirteenth century onward, cherry trees from Mount Yoshino were transplanted to Arashiyama.

units.source_text: 岚山的樱花现已全部凋零，正抽出嫩叶来。

en.t: The cherry blossoms of Arashiyama have now all fallen, and tender new leaves are beginning to emerge.

units.source_text: 花期一过，在这片土地上，花只不过是像已故的美人的名字一样被人叫唤罢了。

en.t: Once the flowering season has passed, in this place the flowers are merely called by name, like the name of a beautiful woman who has died.
